1. New helper `revisedAt(an)` -> updatedAt if it is >1s past createdAt, else null (publishing writes both stamps together, so a stray ms is not an edit).
2. togglePin: before `data: { pinned: !existing.pinned }` -> after `data: { pinned: !existing.pinned, updatedAt: existing.updatedAt }`. Pinning moves the card, not the words, so it must not void accurate reads.
3. updateAnnouncement: title/body are now only written when they actually differ from what is stored, `textChanged` is tracked, and when nothing textual moved it writes `updatedAt: existing.updatedAt` so a no-op save cannot invent an edit.
